dimensions.assessment: Affects institutions of higher education, eligible nonprofit organizations, and scientists engaged in quantum information science.
dimensions.evidence: competitive award of matching grants to institutions of higher education or eligible nonprofit organizations

dimensions.assessment: Provides grant funding and exchange programs for international collaborative research in quantum science under specific security guidelines.
dimensions.evidence: support international scientist exchange programs, including exchange programs that vary in length

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $20,000,000 to be appropriated for fiscal year 2026 to carry out the program.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out the program required by subsection (a) $20,000,000 for fiscal year 2026.

dimensions.assessment: Directs the Department of State to establish a new cooperative program and implement specific research security alignments.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State shall establish and carry out a program

dimensions.assessment: Includes an authorization for fiscal year 2026 and establishes a sunset date terminating the authorities 10 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The authorities under this section shall terminate on the date that is 10 years after the date of the enactment of this title.

missing_information: Specific list of priority countries selected for collaboration beyond statutory criteria
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Secretary of State to establish an international quantum cooperation program featuring matching grants, scientist exchanges, and an authorization of appropriations of $20 million for fiscal year 2026.
